spec.derived_from: Owner earnings, incremental returns, or reinvestment runway fall below the low-case bridge.
spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier for the quality_reinvestment DCF (31.89 USD per share low / 58.05 base / 111.25 high). The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 13,288 USD millions (FY2025 TTM operating cash flow minus capital spending per normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2; anchor accession 0000858877-25-000111). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at FY2026 year-end (2026-07-26) resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and bounded per-share value should compress toward the low case. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-04-26) resolved 12,803 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm; resolve_spec reproduces that value on 2026-09-25. Interim FY2026 TTM readings trend lower through Q3 (Q1 12,733M, Q2 12,241M, Q3 11,788M per sec_companyfacts.json), but Cisco fiscal Q4 is seasonally the strongest cash quarter, so FY-end TTM could still recover above the anchor. Target FY2026 TTM is not observable at registration; FY2026 10-K is not yet listed in CSCO/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json though FY2025 10-K filed 2025-09-03. Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate inputs remain judgment-only and are not typed here. A 38% fire probability weights the trailing decline against Q4 seasonality and historically sticky enterprise networking cash flow.
